feeds.title: Life as a Butterfly Blog
feeds.description: Lifeasabutterfly is a website intended to provide ambition, inspiration, and motivation specializing in tourism research, travel tips, family travel, and holiday planning. Subscribe this blog to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: Cabin Crew Wings Blog
feeds.description: Cabin Crew Wings is the UK's number 1 website for anyone wanting to be Cabin Crew. We provide the most up to date information to help you land cabin crew jobs. Follow this blog on Cabin Crew Selection, Cabin Crew Life and the Cabin Crew Airline Requirements.

feeds.title: AVIATION DREAMER
feeds.description: Welcome to Aviation Dreamer. If you dreamed to become a cabin crew or ground crew, then we are the best option who can guide you or help you regarding airline job interview and interview tips and absolutely free.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Trolley Dolly
feeds.description: Take a peek behind the galley curtain for all your cabin crew and aviation news, gossip and hilarious tales of life as a trolley dolly as we attempt to bring the glamour back to 39,000 feet!

feeds.title: Flying With Foster Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sarah Foster, a New York City-based Flight Attendant who started this blog to help those who wanted to learn more about my career. I post about my travels and answer the frequently asked questions I receive about the life of a Flight Attendant. I also have a degree in Nutrition & Dietetics and love writing about food and health.

feeds.title: Mond Ortiz
feeds.description: All about aviation, planes, airlines, and flight attendants. Get flight reviews, airline news, aviation facts, information on flying, tips, and advice on how to become a flight attendant. Mond Ortiz is an aviation enthusiast in the Philippines with a deep passion for airplanes.

feeds.title: Journey Through Life
feeds.description: A useful blog for those who plan to apply for a Cabin Crew job with Etihad, Qatar or Emirates.

feeds.title: These Gold Wings
feeds.description: Find resources, stories and everything you've ever wanted to know about the flight attendant's life and how to become a cabin crew. These Gold Wings is a team of experienced flight attendants who are passionate about sharing our knowledge and insights with others. We offer a unique perspective on the aviation industry and provide helpful tips for travellers and aspiring flight attendants alike.

feeds.title: Future Flight Attendant Blog
feeds.description: The most accurate information on the internet about becoming a flight attendant. Everything you need to know about the flight attendant career. Future Flight Attendant is dedicated to helping aspiring flight attendants achieve their dreams. Our mission is to provide a comprehensive, flexible, and personalized learning experience through our Online Course & Coaching Program.

feeds.title: Cabin Crew HQ
feeds.description: I have spent years living the nomadic life up in the air as a flight attendant. As a young girl, I was always curious about the fabulous lives of flight attendants. And then after having traveled to and lived on four different continents over a span of 15 years, I discovered my knack for storytelling to inspire others. I took up a mission to share the intimate, funny, illuminating, and rather complicated behind-the-curtain stories.

feeds.title: Boh Tong
feeds.description: This is a Singapore Airlines (SIA) blog. The stories are written by an ex-cabin crew. The stories are about the crew of SIA, especially concerning cabin crew and pilots.

feeds.title: Paddle Your Own Kanoo
feeds.description: It all started back in 2017 when I managed to achieve my dream yet again. The same dream as yours; to become a flight attendant. We devote huge amounts of time, effort and money to achieve this dream. The world of cabin crew recruitment is tough and ultra-competitive. Getting through this ruthless process can sometimes seem like an impossible task. Paddle Your Own Kanoo was borne out the information and knowledge I gained in achieving my dream.

feeds.title: Association of Flight Attendants-CWA News
feeds.description: The Association of Flight Attendants-CWA (AFA-CWA) is the flight attendant union organized by flight attendants for flight attendants. AFA represents nearly 50,000 flight attendants at 19 airlines, serving as a voice for flight attendants at their workplace, in the industry, in the media and on Capitol Hill. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates here.

feeds.title: AeroTime » Cabin Crew
feeds.description: AeroTime is a global multi-channel aviation digital and professional hub providing news, events and advisory services to the aviation world. Our online news platform informs, equips and empowers the aviation industry and its followers. Check out our resources for cabin crew, news, tips and more!

feeds.title: APT Blog
feeds.description: Read and enjoy our latest blogs on air hostess training, career, travel. Visit APT Advantage's blog to know the aviation industry. APT was formed, due to the collective effort of a group of individuals - who realized the huge amount of youth potential being wasted due to the lack of Professional training and guidance in India.

feeds.title: FAC Blog
feeds.description: The Ultimate Resource for Aspiring and Existing Flight Attendants. Our club is made up of a group of passionate flight attendants who have been in the aviation industry for a collective 50 years. We are experts in what we do, having dedicated our careers to serving passengers and our colleagues.

feeds.title: Cabin Crew Safety News
feeds.description: Manage your products and get the latest offers and recommendations. Flying or training, we supply a comprehensive range of aircraft cabin emergency equipment and equivalent reference training devices for aircrew training.

feeds.title: The Flight Attendant Life
feeds.description: This website is the destination for all things related to a flight attendant's lifestyle. From thoughts of how a traveller's life affects relationships, to product recommendations, destination reviews, city guides and humorous stories from the perspective of flight attendants.

feeds.title: World Of Crew
feeds.description: Our goal is to handpick the best offers, discount and benefits for crew from around the world so you can make the most of your time, no matter where you are. It's time to upgrade your crew life!

feeds.title: How to be cabin crew
feeds.description: How to be Cabin Crew is your first source of information when speaking about your career up there in the sky. We provide useful career advice, specialist cabin crew recruitment, job listings and cabin crew training courses. Join our community and learn everything you need to know in order to become a cabin crew!

feeds.title: Cabin Crew Career Center Blog
feeds.description: The Cabin Crew Career Center is a springboard platform for the youth to discover and develop their true potential to provide under one roof, an overview of the scope of flying career opportunities to embark on an exciting career of cabin crew, making your hazy picture in the clouds clear to fly above in the sky and beyond.

feeds.title: Cabin Crew Academy Blog
feeds.description: Have you ever wondered what it's like to be a cabin crew? Read the latest blogs to find out what it's like to fly, experience stopovers, and enjoy some of the most beautiful cities in the World. Cabin Crew Academy offers courses for aviation and tourism enthusiasts to gain in-depth knowledge of Travel and Tourism.

feeds.title: The Classy Cloud
feeds.description: I started The Classy Cloud back in 2014 to share my passion for fashion and travel around my life as a flight attendant. I've been traveling for 18 years now as a cabin crew and I still have itchy feet when I'm up in the air.

feeds.title: The Layover Life
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jess a frequent traveler, passionate foodie and interiors obsessed gal based in London! I began this blog as a way to share my travel tips, and it has since turned into a hub for everything I do in life.

feeds.title: Miss McGarr's Diary
feeds.description: Five hundred, twenty-five thousand, six hundred minutes. Three hundred, seventy-six thousand miles. One hundred eight days in the air. Twenty-one countries. One Girl. Where were you in 1990?

feeds.title: South Jersey Belle
feeds.description: I currently work for the largest airline in the world as a flight attendant. I have designed this blog to share a little peek into my life; including my work, cooking/entertaining, fitness journey, and what I do for fun.

feeds.title: The Dubai Diaries
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Rachel, blogger at The Dubai Diaries, a travel & lifestyle blog which follows my adventures around the world as cabin crew!

feeds.title: A Wheel In The Sky Blog
feeds.description: I'm Toni, a Boston-based flight attendant just looking to share some stories. I work for an airline. I'm constantly on the go for work and hopping on planes to visit distant destinations in my time off. It's not a lifestyle that would suit everyone, but it feels like this life was molded especially for me. This blog is a way of sharing my travel stories, tips and tidbits, and hopefully making someone somewhere laugh along the way. But it's also a way for me to get back to my 'roots.'

feeds.title: Flightess Blog
feeds.description: Jamie Gibson is a leading Luxury Hospitality Expert and Chef. Flightess was founded in 2018 and is now the largest online resource and platform for Corporate Flight Attendants in the world. Flightess is responsible for bringing forth new ideas and innovation in the realms of VIP hospitality with an onboard culinary focus.

feeds.title: C2C Blog
feeds.description: A corporate and private aviation service provider with centres of excellence within the field of: Training, Recruitment, and Outfitting. Offering tailored solutions to meet the needs of individuals and also corporate clients. Explore our blog for more information on our services, tips for aviation crews and more!

feeds.title: Being Cabin Crew Blog
feeds.description: Read more about what really goes on behind the gallery curtain, tips for cabin crew, stories and more!

feeds.title: Cabin Crew Blog
feeds.description: We provide the tips, and courses to apply to Emirates Airlines, Qatar Airways and more! This is a course focusing on Cabin Crew Interviewing Skills by Mr. Le, Thanh Hong Quan (Griffin) - CEO of Careerfinder Vietnam established the exclusive and unique training method Think & Talk that have been helping hundreds of successful candidates are chosen to be a cabin crew of many well-known airlines, such as Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait and more!

feeds.title: ITF Aviation Blog » Cabin Crew
feeds.description: Here you will find an ever-expanding resource covering aviation issues that affect all categories of civil aviation workers including cabin crew, airline ground staff, pilots, airport workers and air traffic management staff.

feeds.title: Flight Attendant Institute Blog
feeds.description: Christina Ling is a former Canadian Airlines International In-Charge Flight Attendant/First Class Flight Attendant/Business Class Flight Attendant/Peer trainer and former Program Leader and Lead Flight Attendant Instructor. She is a daughter of two airline veterans and was born with jet fuel in her veins! She's deeply passionate about sharing her experiences and love of aviation with her students. She will help you land your dream career as a Flight Attendant! She will coach, guide and mentor you to achieve your goals in becoming a Flight Attendant or any Aviation Customer Service position.

feeds.title: Cabin Chronicle
feeds.description: Check out Guadalupe Castaneda's chronicles as cabin crew, interesting stories, tips, life as a cabin crew and more!

feeds.title: 24 Hours Layover
feeds.description: Flight attendant turned full-time travel blogger making travel easier for you: this is your go-to guide for female and solo travel.

feeds.title: Moira's Travel Blog. With Emirates Cabin Crew On The Side.
feeds.description: This blog is a Travel Blog. It is personal and logs mine and my family's travels. Up to 2015 it had information related to the Cabin Crew who work for Air Emirates. As my daughter no longer works for this airline the information on here may not be up to date. Our new interests include cycling holidays and the odd cruise

feeds.title: Flying With A Baby
feeds.description: Flying With A Baby covers ALL you need to know about family travel with kids from baby to 10 years old. Hotel & airline reviews, travel gear, sleep tips, travel toys & more - by an ex flight attendant.Hello, I'm Carrie, and I have over 12 years flying experience as a long haul flight attendant and have visited over 60 countries. I cover all aspects of flying with children and provide tips, reviews and inspiration for family holidays.

feeds.title: Keeping Up with Kerry
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Kerry May, I'm 24 years old and from London, UK. Today I received my golden call from Emirates airline, congratulating me and offering me the job as Cabin Crew. I will be moving to Dubai on 27 July 2018! I started this blog so that friends and family can keep up with my travels and see what I've been getting up to. I also loved reading other peoples blogs during the recruitment process and found the information extremely helpful and motivating. Hopefully sharing my experience will help others along the way too.

feeds.title: Jetlagged Comic Blog
feeds.description: Jetlagged Comic is a comic strip for flight crews and people who travel a lot. Cartoons for flight attendants, pilots, agents and passengers. Created by current flight attendant/cartoonist Kelly Kincaid.

feeds.title: Airline Career Blog
feeds.description: Joseph Belotti is the President of AirlineCareer.com, a Boston based company and an award winning website that provides guidance and coaching to individuals seeking flight attendant careers. This Blog offers Flight Attendant Hiring Updates, Career Advice and Airline Industry News from AirlineCareer.com.

feeds.title: Danielle Murnane
feeds.description: Hello, I am Danielle Murnane, a travel enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. I am currently living in Doha, where I am working as Cabin Crew for Qatar Airways. This is my personal blog for you to follow my adventures as I travel the world!

feeds.title: Delhi Air Hostess Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Delhi Air Hostess Academy provides professional aviation training to students in order to help them advance their careers in airports, hospitality sectors, and airline corporations. Delhi Air Hostess Academy is a one-of-a-kind comprehensive one-stop educational college with professional expertise in offering professional aviation qualifications to fulfil the growing demand for skilled labour in the aviation industry. Read our blog for more information on our courses, training, tips and advice and more!
